first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: The slender dark gray-black long gun at the bottom edge of the image, with conspicuous light-colored mottling and bright metallic edges on the gun body.

entities.name: muddy shell-cratered ground
entities.identification: The dark, undulating muddy ground extending from the foreground to the midground, with a higher slope on the left and a wet, reflective low-lying area on the right.

entities.name: cluster of dead trees
entities.identification: Multiple gray-black leafless tree trunks in the midground and background, with thicker nearby trees interspersed with thin, small distant trees; some retain short branches.

entities.name: smoke-cloud-filled sky
entities.identification: The hazy gray-white and yellow-green sky background above the sloping ground and between the tree trunks, with a warm orange area at the upper left in the final frame.

entities.name: orange point of fire
entities.identification: Small patches of orange-yellow open flame on the midground and background ground surface, distributed in multiple locations at the beginning and still visible on the right in the final frame.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The close-up dark-gloved hand and wrist connected to Weapon A; the face and full body are outside the image.

entities.name: shell-crater water
entities.identification: The gray-green, irregular, reflective water surface in a low area of the muddy ground, with bright areas separated by dark clods of mud and rocks.

entities.name: black speck overlay
entities.identification: The blurry gray-black, nearly circular spots and irregular dark blotches at and near the top edge of the image, some of which allow the background to show through.
